dimension: network with disconnected components and unreachable stops
expected: unreachable stops stay listed with reasons and the blocked precondition is reported; no partial route is drawn as a solution

dimension: tolerance extreme on a million-vertex generalisation request
expected: the request is refused while the algorithm path has no admitted whitelist entry; input hash is unchanged either way

dimension: tessellation of an irregular extent with sliver cells
expected: gap and zero-overlap algebra is asserted at the candidate tolerance and any sliver is reported, never merged silently

dimension: significance classes on sparse data with a single-member cluster
expected: an unmet method precondition returns inapplicable rather than a significance class; decoration never manufactures significance

dimension: pyramid rebuild interrupted, then re-run on the same raster
expected: full-resolution values and statistics remain unchanged, the re-run adds no level, and the in-place mutation is disclosed as a side effect

dimension: raster pair misaligned by a third of a cell for reprojection
expected: the offset is quantified and the change matrix withheld; no silent resample is presented as an aligned result

dimension: band composition request across differing pixel types and origins
expected: composition is refused naming the missing algorithm path, and no expression workaround is reported as verified band assembly

dimension: a thousand-zone histogram table with empty zones
expected: per-zone totals recompute, empty zones stay reported as empty and are never merged into a neighbour

dimension: NoData flood in change detection with half the common extent invalid
expected: excluded pixels are counted and disclosed and never classified as change; class totals still recompute

dimension: point sampling on edges, NoData cells and outside the extent
expected: each point class carries its own stated reason and inputs remain byte-unchanged

dimension: layout template export then import with a name collision
expected: conflictPolicy decides the outcome explicitly and no existing layout is silently replaced; slot set and style tokens survive the round trip

dimension: deletion cascade with dependents, requested without confirmation
expected: deletion is refused without confirmDelete and any cascade must list every dependent element removed

dimension: data package whose dependency breaks between export and validation
expected: validation in strict mode names the broken dependency and the mismatched artifact, and refuses overwrite of the existing package

dimension: modern-format read-back with an unsupported container requested
expected: the unsupported format is refused with a named capability gap and is never degraded silently into a supported container
